tools.name: ask
tools.description: Show questions to the user on a local web board and keep working: the answers come later, through collect. `items` holds the questions (`type: "question"`); a question's `props.items` holds its widgets, excerpts and molecules. Every item is `{type, id, props}`, with an ID of your choosing that matches [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64} and is unique in the ask. Write content and data only: no HTML, CSS, script, colours or positions, since AskBoard lays the board out. Point to project files instead of copying them (`path#Heading`, `path#L10-L40`). Never compute totals, estimates, dates or margins: AskBoard derives them. The askboard skill lists every item type and its props. Returns the board link and the ask's first cursor.

tools.name: collect
tools.description: Return what happened on your asks after the cursors you pass: answers (only what changed, with derived values), declines, postpones, follow-ups, notes and state changes. Pass the latest cursor you received for each ask, and ignore an event whose cursor you have already seen. With `wait`, return as soon as that item has an event, or after 20 minutes. A `discarded` ask is gone and its answers will not come.
